description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate context-aware medical exam questions with detailed instructions, explanations, and references for creating high-quality MCQs.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for creating a medical exam question based on difficulty, context, and optional image context, including instructions, explanation format, and response structure.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating a generated MCQ, focusing on accuracy, clarity, and quality, including detailed criteria and response format.
